install.description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product and replaces it in SwiftPM's install folder

release-publish.description: Attaches the zips a release build wrote to the project's GitHub release and adds notarized apps to their Sparkle feeds

run.description: Runs swift or xcodebuild invocations in order, with Nx's per-task environment removed

zip.description: Zips each archived app and each SwiftPM executable product's release build, exporting, notarizing, and stapling a Developer ID app first under a notary profile
